toggle_12mm.description: Full size bat handle toggle, 15/32-32 NS threaded bushing (12 mm class)
toggle_12mm.source: PLACEHOLDER: typical values for the 15/32 in bushing class, not taken from a real part. Replace with calipers on the toggles you mount.

toggle_6mm.description: Miniature bat handle toggle, 1/4-40 UNS threaded bushing (6 mm class)
toggle_6mm.source: PLACEHOLDER: typical datasheet values for a miniature toggle with a 1/4-40 bushing 8.9 mm (0.35 in) long, in the style of the C&K 7000 series, not taken from a real part. max_panel_t is the bushing less two nuts and a lock washer; keepout_d is judgement, room for a fingertip and the 5/16 in nut wrench. Replace with calipers on the toggles you mount.

encoder_knob.description: Incremental rotary encoder with push, M7 x 0.75 threaded bushing 9 mm long, 6 mm D shaft, with a knurled machined aluminium knob
encoder_knob.source: PLACEHOLDER: typical datasheet values for a 12 mm square body incremental encoder with push switch and a long M7 x 0.75 bushing, in the style of the Alps EC11 and Bourns PEC11R series, 20 detents with both contacts open at rest; not taken from a real part. max_panel_t is the bushing less two nuts and a washer, the back nut setting how far the bushing stands proud. Knob in the style of a 30 mm knurled aluminium instrument knob. keepout_d is judgement, room for fingers around the knob. Replace with calipers on the encoder and knob you mount.

rotary_switch.description: Rotary switch, 1 pole 6 positions, 3/8-32 UNEF threaded bushing, 6 mm shaft, with a skirted bakelite pointer knob
rotary_switch.source: PLACEHOLDER: typical datasheet values for a 1 pole 12 way rotary switch with its end stop set to 6 positions and a 3/8-32 bushing 9.5 mm (3/8 in) long, in the style of the Lorlin CK series; not taken from a real part. max_panel_t is the bushing less two 1/2 in nuts and a washer. Knob in the style of a 30 mm skirted bakelite pointer knob. keepout_d is judgement, room for fingers around the knob. Replace with calipers on the switch and knob you mount.

pushbutton_16mm.description: Metal momentary pushbutton, 16 mm threaded body, flat head, normally open
pushbutton_16mm.source: PLACEHOLDER: typical datasheet values for a 16 mm stainless anti-vandal momentary pushbutton with solder lugs, in the style of the Onpow GQ16 series; not taken from a real part. The head clamps the face against one back nut, so max_panel_t is the thread less the nut and a washer. body is the thread left behind the nut plus the switch and lugs. keepout_d is judgement, room for a fingertip and the nut wrench. Replace with calipers on the buttons you mount.

esp32_devboard.description: ESP32-H2 board (Zigbee, no wifi) with an onboard PCB antenna at one end and a USB connector at the other
esp32_devboard.source: PLACEHOLDER: envelope of a generic ESP32 dev board, not a chosen part. The radio decision needs an ESP32-H2. Antenna keepout is a rule of thumb for PCB antennas; check the module datasheet. Replace with the board you use.

battery_2aa_holder.description: Two AA cells end to end in the printed inline holder, screwed to the cavity floor
battery_2aa_holder.source: Envelope of cad/holders/battery_2aa_holder.scad (regen_all.py checks it). Cells per IEC 60086 LR6 maximum, 14.5 x 50.5. contact_space in the model is a placeholder until the bought contacts are measured.
